description: This file defines the 'Zend_Http_Client_Adapter_Socket' class, implementing a socket-based HTTP adapter for Zend Framework's HTTP client. It provides methods for connecting, sending requests, reading responses, and managing stream contexts, facilitating HTTP communication without requiring additional PHP extensions.

classes.name: Zend_Http_Client_Adapter_Socket
classes.description: A socket-based adapter class for Zend_Http_Client enabling HTTP communication through stream sockets, supporting connection management, request writing, response reading, and stream context configurations.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the adapter; currently empty, configuration set via setConfig().

methods.name: setConfig
methods.description: Sets the configuration options for the socket adapter, accepting arrays or Zend_Config objects.

methods.name: setStreamContext
methods.description: Sets the stream context resource or creates one from an array of options.

methods.name: getStreamContext
methods.description: Retrieves the current stream context resource, creating a default if none is set.

methods.name: connect
methods.description: Establishes a socket connection to the specified host and port, optionally secure via SSL.

methods.name: write
methods.description: Sends an HTTP request with specified method, URI, headers, and body to the server via the socket.

methods.name: read
methods.description: Reads the HTTP response from the socket, handling headers, chunked transfer encoding, and content-length.

methods.name: _checkSocketReadTimeout
methods.description: Checks if the socket read operation timed out and throws an exception if so.

methods.name: setOutputStream
methods.description: Sets a resource stream where the response will be written.

methods.name: __destruct
methods.description: Ensures socket disconnection upon object destruction unless persistent connection is configured.
